name: Wait anchor for advance bookings when the driver is early
statement: Ryde profile only. For an ADVANCE booking, the wait starts at the later of the driver's arrival and scheduled_time. Ryde's rider policy does not say where the wait starts when the driver is early; an older driver article counts from arrival, which read literally would allow a fee before the scheduled time. FairRyde follows Grab and Bolt and records the conflict.

sources.quote: Your driver will arrive early and wait for you for up to 15 minutes starting from the indicated pickup time.
The scheduled wait time of 5 minutes will be counted only from the scheduled start of the ride.
You arrived at the pickup location and the customer was not present within 3 minutes of your arrival.
